messages:
Jamie (Support): FYI we've got an urgent ticket from a customer (org: acme-corp) — their SIEM shows a gap in audit events for `policy.delete` between 2026-03-12T22:00Z and 2026-03-13T03:00Z. They say user_id and principal fields are missing on many events.
Asha (Eng-Security): Thx. Do we have the forwarder job id / batch IDs for that window? Also need the S3 prefix + bucket.
Jamie (Support): Customer sent S3 path: s3://redwood-exports/acme-corp/2026/03/12/ and latest manifest shows deliveries but counts don't match SIEM. Forwarder job: audit-forwarder-7f8b.
Ravi (SRE): Pinging infra-oncall, can you check if there were KMS errors around that time? If envelope decryption failed we may have dropped or re-encrypted events.
infra-oncall: I see repeated `KMS: AccessDenied` errors in the forwarder logs from 2026-03-12T22:10Z to 22:45Z for role `forwarder-role-acme`. Log snippet: ```2026-03-12T22:12:03Z audit-forwarder-7f8b ERROR kms_decrypt: AccessDenied: User not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd...```
Asha (Eng-Security): That would explain stripping of identity fields if we fallback to redaction flow. Does the forwarder have a fallback that nulls out principal fields on KMS failures?
Ravi (SRE): Yes — current logic marks events as `redacted: true` and strips `user_id`, `principal`. It's in `forwarder/redaction_handler.go`. We have a partial fix but need to confirm whether these events were later reprocessed.
Jamie (Support): Customer insists they didn't get replays in SIEM. They want all original events. Ticket INC-2026-045 created.
infra-oncall: Quick check: the S3 manifests for the affected timeframe show files present. Sizes match expected but the manifest records `encryption: kms` and several objects have `kms_status: failed`.
Asha (Eng-Security): Action items: 1) Confirm whether forwarder retried those objects after KMS perms were fixed. 2) If not retried, plan replay from S3 but preserve original plaintext fields. 3) Provide customer a duplication-safe replay plan (they don't want duplicates).
Ravi (SRE): To reproduce locally: run `./bin/audit-forwarder --bucket redwood-exports --prefix acme-corp/2026/03/12 --simulate-kms-failure` which will exercise the redaction path. I ran and reproduced `user_id` removal.
Asha (Eng-Security): Good repro. For mitigation I can patch the forwarder to mark events with `kms_failure=true` instead of stripping and keep original payload in a sealed archive so we can replay after fix. That avoids silent data loss.
infra-oncall: Short-term customer workaround: we can run replay using a dedupe key on `event_id`. Proposed command: `aws lambda invoke --function-name forwarder-replay --payload '{"prefix":"acme-corp/2026/03/12"}'` (ops-only). Note: will re-send all events, SIEM should dedupe by event_id if configured.
Jamie (Support): I'll coordinate with customer on enabling dedupe on their SIEM side. Also escalating to legal/compliance for potential data retention incident.
Asha (Eng-Security): Can someone grep for other orgs with `kms_decrypt` AccessDenied spikes in the same window? Might be a role-wide IAM rotation that affected multiple tenants.
Ravi (SRE): Running query now across forwarder logs: `fields @timestamp, job, error | filter error like /AccessDenied/ and @timestamp between 2026-03-12T22:00:00Z and 2026-03-13T04:00:00Z | stats count() by job` — will post results in thread when done.
siem-bot: Reminder: SIEM ingestion will drop duplicates by default for up to 24h unless dedupe explicitly disabled.
Asha (Eng-Security): Next steps: (a) Ravi to finish log sweep and list impacted orgs, (b) infra-oncall to run replay plan for acme-corp after ops greenlight, (c) I will prepare post-incident note and proposed forwarder patch.
Jamie (Support): Customer call scheduled for 2026-03-13T16:00Z PT. I'll update them with the timeline and the dedupe/replay plan.
Ravi (SRE): Log sweep done — 5 orgs total showed same KMS AccessDenied pattern (acme-corp, bambu-inc, cerulean, data-scout, envysoft).
Asha (Eng-Security): Marking this P1 for eng-security/infra. Adding to board and linking INC-2026-045. I'll open a PR for the non-destructive fallback today.
infra-oncall: After IAM fix at 2026-03-13T01:20Z, forwarder retried ~60% of failed objects automatically; remaining require manual replay. Will list object keys in INC ticket.
Jamie (Support): Noted. I'll share manual replay checklist with the customer and ask for SIEM dedupe confirmation before we run it. :thumbsup:
Asha (Eng-Security): Thanks all — capturing this in postmortem template.
